International Admissions
Your journey at UMSL starts here!
Applying is easy, and you can get a head start by preparing your application materials now. Once you apply, you will be able to upload your documents directly to your online portal, helping us process your application faster. Official documents will still be required later, but taking this first step ensures you are on the path to joining our vibrant community. Please note that we cannot accept documents via email.
Do not wait—apply now and take the first step toward your future at UMSL!
Apply for Admission
Applying to UMSL is simple, and we are here to help you every step of the way. Follow these steps to start your journey:
Submit Your Application
Complete the international student application and submit the $40 application fee.
Submit Proof of English Proficiency
Minimum requirements vary by department, but it is recommended that graduate applicants have at least a:
TOEFL: 79 (4.5)
IELTS Academic: 6.5
Cambridge English C1 Advanced: 180
PTE-A: 59
Duolingo: 115
Submit Your Transcripts
To give us a full picture of your achievements, submit unofficial copies of your transcripts:
Current University Students: Send us your university transcripts to date.
University Graduates: Send us a copy of your final transcripts and degree certificates
Remember, we need transcripts from every college and university you attended.
Submit Your Supplemental Materials
Most graduate programs require additional materials, such as letters of recommendation, resume/CV, writing samples, or standardized test scores (GRE or GMAT). To ensure you have everything ready for the department to review, check the degree profile for your program and submit any required supplemental materials.
Letters of recommendation must be submitted directly by the recommender through the application system—please avoid sending photocopies or scans.
We are excited for you to take the leap and start your journey to UMSL. Apply today!
Submit Your Immigration Items
You can submit your immigration documents with your application or after you receive your admission decision. Having them on file early helps speed up processing once you are admitted.
Required Immigration Documents for F-1 Students:
Copy of Your Passport
Your passport should be valid for at least six months beyond your intended stay in the U.S.
Make sure the Visual Inspection Zone and Machine-readable Zone are clear and complete.
Statement of Finances
Submit an official bank statement, loan certificate, or scholarship letter that:
Shows enough funds to cover one year of expenses
Is in English and less than six months old
Bank statements should display liquid assets (Checking Account, Savings Account, etc.)
UMSL Affidavit of Support
Other affidavit formats will not be considered.
Copy of Any Current U.S. Visa
Copy of your current I-20
If you are an F-1 student already in the U.S.
Understand Your Estimated Costs
Planning for your education is an important step, and we are here to help. Below, you will find estimated expenses for the students admitted to Spring 2027. U.S. regulations require students to demonstrate proof of financial support in order to receive documentation for a student visa. Actual costs may vary, and you will not be billed until you register for classes.

Important Notes
Tuition, fees, and living expenses are based on projected estimates for the 2026-2027 academic year and may change. It is important to plan for annual increases.
Estimates reflect the minimum credit hours required by federal regulations and specific academic programs.
Scholarship recipients and some academic programs may have different credit hour requirements.
Learn About UMSL Scholarships
Graduate Assistantships
Graduate Assistantships are awarded directly by the department, and we encourage you to reach out to the Graduate Program Director to explore possible funding opportunities. While these assistantships are limited and not all programs offer them, rest assured that all students not awarded a Graduate Assistantship will automatically be considered for our International Merit Scholarships.
Scholarships
If you do not receive a Graduate Assistantship, you will automatically be considered for this scholarship, with no separate application required. Our scholarships provide a significant reduction in tuition costs, helping you focus on achieving your academic goals.
These opportunities are exclusively available to F-1 International Students and are contingent upon maintaining legal F-1 status and satisfactory academic progress.
Priority Application Deadlines
Apply Early to Stay on Track!
Applying early ensures you stay on track to achieve your goals. We recommend submitting all your application and immigration materials before the priority deadlines listed below. Applying early gives you the best chance to secure your visa and enroll in your preferred semester, all while avoiding longer wait times for visa appointments as the semester approaches.
* Keep in mind that some graduate programs may have earlier deadlines. Make sure to check the degree profile for your program and meet the deadline that comes first.
